# NRV2XRelaySelection

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process of selecting an optimal relay node in New Radio Vehicle-to-Everything (NR-V2X) communications to minimize latency and improve reliability in vehicular networks. This is a key application domain for TCC/iNEST, showing how topology-centric computing can be applied to real-time, mobility-driven network optimization.
